RUST BROWSER / PHASE 4

The flow notebook

Nested boxes, shaped text and asynchronous images. Painted by the same display list on GPU and software.

Readable documentation

Flow keeps bold text, italic text and inline highlights on a common baseline. A shaped link remains clickable after wrapping and scrolling.

Margins between paragraphs collapse rather than adding twice. The section owns its background, border and padding instead of flattening into separate article paragraphs.

Inline replaced content

A tiny PNG shares the line with text. A missing image preserves its alternative text.

English mixed with العربية and עברית — bidi shaping stays in Rust.
